_comment: Pinned build inputs, fetched into third_party/ as plain git clones by scripts/fetch_sources.sh. NOT submodules by design: SwiftPM recursively initializes submodules of git dependencies, which would make every consumer clone the full Skia + HarfBuzz history (~1.1 GB) for a ~23 MB binary product.

skia.note: m150 (SkMilestone.h), canvaskit/0.41.0 lineage; term-kit production pin

harfbuzz.note: reports 14.2.0; post-14.2.0 main commit, term-kit production pin

macos_base.note: The macos-arm64 slice of this release is the 150.1.0 one, reused byte-for-byte rather than rebuilt (Skia/HarfBuzz pins are unchanged, and a rebuild is not bit-reproducible). scripts/fetch_macos_base.sh downloads + hash-verifies these two assets; scripts/package.sh re-wraps them; scripts/verify.sh proves every archive and header is identical. Delete this key to go back to building macOS from source (required whenever the skia/harfbuzz pins or gn/macos.gn change).
